headline: German Craft Sector Warns of Up to 80,000 Annual Job Losses
summary: German Confederation of Skilled Crafts (ZDH) President Jörg Dittrich warned that reduced order volumes and rising operational costs could lead to the loss of up to 80,000 jobs per year in the craft sector without policy interventions.
why: Small-scale trades and craft enterprises form a key pillar of employment and industrial subcontracting in Germany.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: Job contraction in skilled trades reflects persistent headwinds in Germany's domestic economy.
